info.title: Los Olivos Premio
info.description: Shared API for Node and Neon with transactional persistence. No purchase is required. When presenceRequired is enabled, staff must explicitly approve the physically present phone before participation; the short-lived browser-bound visit is consumed atomically. Changes to this rule require fresh owner review. Prior accepted entries and idempotent replays remain valid. Real coupons reserve stock and expire normally. An explicitly requested TST test coupon is isolated, never redeemable and retained only until operator deletion. Administrative mutations require session and CSRF. Contact and owner review persist across restarts.

x-neon-transport.deviceStorage: Frontend localStorage, scoped to the API origin; only an in-memory fallback when unavailable.
x-neon-transport.sessionStorage: Frontend sessionStorage; 8-hour server expiry and database-backed revocation.
x-neon-transport.cors: Exact frontend origin; preflight allows Authorization, Content-Type, X-CSRF-Token, X-Olivos-Device and Idempotency-Key. No wildcard or third-party cookies.
x-neon-transport.rateLimit: Persistent global limits; client forwarding headers are not trusted.

get.summary: Process health only; reveals no business state or credentials.
Campaign rules and available prizes; establishes a signed device cookie (Node) or returns X-Olivos-Device (Neon), without counting a participation.

200.description: Campaign, rules, prizes and availability. No test-mode field.

X-Olivos-Device.description: Neon only: persist and return this signed device credential on later API requests.

post.summary: Atomically register one explicit participation, consuming an approved visit for this browser when presenceRequired. Reserve one prize on a winning position. Replaying the same key and device returns the original result even after visit expiry or consumption; omit visitId for a replay if it is unavailable.

200.description: Accepted or replayed; won=true contains a private Coupon.

403.description: DAILY_CODE_REQUIRED: missing, expired or incorrect local code.

409.description: VISIT_REQUIRED (missing, unapproved, expired, consumed or other browser), CAMPAIGN_PAUSED or PROMOTION_NOT_READY; no participation counted and no visit consumed.

error.message: Solicita al personal que valide tu visita presencial antes de participar.

429.description: COOLDOWN or RATE_LIMITED. retryAt identifies the next allowed time; Retry-After is in seconds.

get.summary: Read this signed browser's current visit and rolling cooldown. Never participates or reveals another browser hash. Removes expired requests on access; used visits may remain visible until expiry.

post.summary: Create or reuse one unconsumed request for this browser. Pending request expires in ten minutes. No purchase, result, participation or stock reservation. Requires an active, ready campaign with stock and no 24-hour cooldown; limited to 20 requests/minute per trusted IP on Node, globally on Neon, and 1000 retained requests.
Cancel an unused request only if owned by this browser. Idempotent and does not reveal whether another browser owns that ID. Does not refund a consumed visit.

get.summary: PNG directing staff to admin.html#visit=<id>. Possession only permits opening the lookup; GET never approves or participates. QR requires the full random ID, never the short staff code.
Return coupons issued to or explicitly saved by this signed device cookie. No enumeration without ownership or the private token.

post.summary: Idempotently bookmark a coupon in this browser using its private bearer token. Retains the original owner, status, stock and participation count. Up to 100 additional browsers per coupon.

200.description: { saved: true }; repeated saves do not duplicate the coupon.

409.description: WALLET_LIMIT_REACHED: coupon has reached the saved-browser limit.

get.summary: Read a coupon using its unguessable bearer token. Possession of the link grants access. Does not redeem.
PNG QR containing the administrative validation link, not the private coupon token.
QR pointing to configured PUBLIC_URL. A localhost URL is not reachable from a phone.

post.summary: Verify password; establish an HttpOnly SameSite session cookie (Node) or X-Olivos-Session bearer credential (Neon). Rate limited. Never returns password/hash.

200.description: { ok: true }; session revoked. Neon clears X-Olivos-Session.

get.summary: Totals, last 100 participations, coupons, inventory, daily activity and safe configuration (never secret hashes).

patch.summary: Update validated rules, contact and explicit owner review. Contact/rule changes, including presenceRequired, invalidate prior review unless explicitly reconfirmed in the same request. An active production campaign rejects unreviewed changes without partial mutation. Old entries, counters and stock remain intact. Legacy deployment values are fallback defaults only.

presenceRequired.description: Require a staff-approved, single-use browser-bound physical visit. No purchase required. Absent in legacy state means false; no automatic activation.

promotionContact.description: Public contact, trimmed before storage. Empty is allowed only while paused.

promotionReviewed.description: Explicit administrator confirmation of published terms/privacy. Server records promotionReviewedAt; the client cannot supply that timestamp.

409.description: CYCLE_IN_PROGRESS; current cycle must complete before interval can change.

get.summary: Look up the full random visit ID or short VIS code so staff can compare the physically present phone. Never approves or returns a browser hash.

post.summary: Explicit staff attestation that this code is on the phone physically present, without purchase. Approval lasts ten minutes and is audited, but does not register participation or reveal a result. Re-approval is idempotent and never extends expiry; consumed requests cannot be reapproved.

patch.summary: Set available, unreserved units. Existing reservations remain unchanged.

get.summary: Validate before showing an explicit redemption confirmation. GET never redeems.

post.summary: Atomically redeem one unexpired real coupon. Stock was reserved at issue. TST test coupons are always read-only.

409.description: COUPON_REDEEMED, COUPON_EXPIRED or TEST_COUPON. A held test winner remains active; no business stock or records change.

get.summary: CSV coupon register. Contains no private bearer tokens or anonymous device hashes.

neonSession.description: Neon Functions only: use the X-Olivos-Session credential from login. Never put it in a URL.

Code.name: code
Code.description: OLV is a real coupon. TST is a private, read-only winning test coupon and cannot be redeemed.

Session.description: Session established or restored. On Neon login, persist the X-Olivos-Session response header in sessionStorage and send Authorization: Bearer on admin requests.

X-Olivos-Session.description: Neon login only: private session credential. Never log or place in a URL.

VisitState.description: Current visit (or null), presence rule and cooldownUntil. No browser hash.

Visit.description: Safe visit view. No participation result or browser hash.

VisitNotFound.description: VISIT_NOT_FOUND: missing or expired; request a fresh code.

RateLimited.description: COOLDOWN or RATE_LIMITED. When retryAt is present, wait until it; Retry-After is in seconds.

Forbidden.description: FORBIDDEN; origin or CSRF validation failed.

testOnly.description: When true, this is a noncommercial test winner: no stock reservation or participation, no expiry or redemption, retained until explicit deletion.

VisitId.description: 128-bit random ID. Not an approval credential; only its original signed browser may use it after staff approval.
